title: RASopathy mutations open new insights into the mechanism of BRAF activation.
abstract: Spencer-Smith et al. (2022)1 investigate multiple functions of the BRAF cysteine-rich domain (CRD), finding distinct classes of RASopathy-associated BRAF mutations and unique features among RAF paralogs that may contribute to the spectrum of mutations observed in disease.
